scripts.local:dev: pnpm local:setup && pnpm identity:check && pnpm identity:up && pnpm local:wait && pnpm dev
scripts.local:reset: pnpm local:setup && docker compose --env-file infra/compose/authentik/.env -f infra/compose/authentik/compose.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans
scripts.local:status: pnpm local:setup && docker compose --env-file infra/compose/authentik/.env -f infra/compose/authentik/compose.yml ps
scripts.local:logs: pnpm local:setup && docker compose --env-file infra/compose/authentik/.env -f infra/compose/authentik/compose.yml logs -f server worker
scripts.identity:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/compose/authentik/.env -f infra/compose/authentik/compose.yml logs -f server worker
scripts.server:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/compose/server/.env -f infra/compose/server/compose.yml logs -f authentik-server authentik-worker headscale caddy
